q: 补全关系型数据库索引的要点：
q_en: Fill in the key points about relational database indexes:
text: 索引通常用 {{B-Tree}} 或{{哈希表}}实现；关系库的优势是支持任意多个索引，还支持{{多列}}索引与专用索引（地理空间、全文）。

termDefinitions.meaning: 键到存储位置的映射结构，等值查询接近 O(1)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hash table maps keys to storage locations for near constant-time equality lookups.

A deadlock: both sides wait on each other; keep lock logic centralized to prevent it

q: 补全三种缓存写策略：
q_en: Fill in the three cache write strategies:
text: {{Write-Through}}：同时写缓存和底层存储，一致但写更慢；{{Write-Around}}：绕过缓存直接写存储，减少缓存污染但后续读可能变慢；{{Write-Back}}：先写缓存、异步落库，写快但缓存故障可能丢数据。
why: 三种写策略是「一致性、读性能、写性能」间的取舍：Write-Through 求一致、Write-Around 防污染、Write-Back 求写速但担丢失风险。
why_en: Write-through favors consistency, write-around avoids cache pollution, and write-back is fastest for writes but risks data loss.

termDefinitions.meaning: 写入直接落底层存储、绕过缓存，减少缓存污染。
